meta.task: smartphone battery: volumetric energy density >= 950 Wh/L; 4C fast charge with no lithium plating; maximum temperature <= 50 C; anode SEI thickness <= 500 nm after 100 cycles; voltage plateau >= 4.1 V

threshold_notes.plateau_key: midpoint_voltage_v (calc-energy plateau approximation: voltage at discharge-time midpoint)
threshold_notes.energy_density_wh_l: calc-energy contract caliber (electrolyte/casing excluded, annotated by tool)

meta.base_selection_basis: task text names no electrode system -> anchor table default Chen2020; verified by parameter dump: NMC811/graphite (OCP functions nmc_LGM50_ocp_Chen2020), nominal 5 Ah, full thermal/geometry set, SEI kinetics present, no plating parameters (standard defaults injected at runtime)

ablation.ceiling_escalation: OFF (task text: no proactive escalation into material design; only materials/systems named in task text may be used; otherwise tune within the existing cell/architecture formulation space)
ablation.exploration_force: ON (default; not disabled by task text)
ablation.funnel_voting: ON (default; unused - no Stage 2 in this case)

freedoms.electrode_system: locked: Chen2020 (no system named in task text; ceiling_escalation OFF forbids proactive system switch)
freedoms.electrolyte_formulation: locked: baseline transport parameters (no materials/additives named in task text)
freedoms.electrode_modification: locked: no coating/doping (not named in task text)
freedoms.cell_architecture: adjustable: thickness / porosity / N-P / separator / current collectors / particle size (parameter keys verified against Chen2020); plus electrode formulation keys (active material volume fraction, with porosity co-adjusted to keep volume fractions physical) and nominal capacity (kept consistent with designed loading so 1C remains a true 1C) as part of the cell/architecture formulation space - widest interpretation recorded
freedoms.thermal_management: adjustable: Total heat transfer coefficient (cooling h) within smartphone passive-cooling range 10-25 W/m2K; cell cooling surface area kept at parameter-set value - widest interpretation recorded

protocols.fast_charge: run-pyamm 4C_charge_45C --thermal lumped --plating (45 C ambient, charge from empty)
protocols.aging: run-pyamm aging_1C_100cyc (spme, isothermal, SEI ec reaction limited, 100 cycles)
